recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-26559 unless a future validation pass identifies a different StructureDefinition-example defect outside this issue's narrow slice-id request.
issue_request: FHIR-26559 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction asking that StructureDefinition-example slice element ids use slice-name colon syntax, for example DiagnosticReport.result:Cholesterol, instead of dotted ids such as DiagnosticReport.result.Cholesterol.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-26559 was found. Git pickaxe history shows the dotted ElementDefinition.id values were introduced when ids were added in 6a68b1e676, and the current source later changed the relevant StructureDefinition example and copied invariant-test fixtures from dotted ids to colon ids in 7ad13b103c.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms this was a narrow STU3 StructureDefinition-example defect and reports it as the only resource with the issue. source/fhir.ini lists StructureDefinition as an active resource, so source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-example.xml is in current build scope. Related Jira and Confluence searches found no separate final decision that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-example.xml has DiagnosticReport.result:Cholesterol, DiagnosticReport.result:Triglyceride, DiagnosticReport.result:HDLCholesterol, and DiagnosticReport.result:LDLCholesterol, and an exact current-source search found no remaining DiagnosticReport.result.Cholesterol dotted id.
